27inline size_t clamped_upper(size_t upper, size_t guard, size_t lower) {

35template <typename T>
36inline void compute_rhs_K(const BSSNGridSoA<T> &G, Field3D<T> &rhs_K, size_t padding = 4) {
37 using namespace tensorium_RG::fd;
38 const T ko_sigma = T(0.1);
39
40 size_t I0, I1, J0, J1, K0, K1;
41 G.domain_bounds(I0, I1, J0, J1, K0, K1);
42
43 const size_t total = G.K.st.nx_tot * G.K.st.ny_tot * G.K.st.nz_tot;
44 std::fill(rhs_K.ptr(), rhs_K.ptr() + total, T(0));
45
46 const size_t i0 = clamped_lower(I0, padding, I1);
47 const size_t j0 = clamped_lower(J0, padding, J1);
48 const size_t k0 = clamped_lower(K0, padding, K1);
49 const size_t i1 = clamped_upper(I1, padding, I0);
50 const size_t j1 = clamped_upper(J1, padding, J0);
51 const size_t k1 = clamped_upper(K1, padding, K0);
52
53 if (i0 >= i1 || j0 >= j1 || k0 >= k1)
54 return;
55
56 const T third = T(1) / T(3);
57
58#pragma omp parallel for collapse(2)
59 for (size_t i = i0; i < i1; ++i) {
60 for (size_t j = j0; j < j1; ++j) {
61 for (size_t k = k0; k < k1; ++k) {
62 const size_t id = G.K.idx(i, j, k);
63
64 const T alpha = G.alpha.ptr()[id];
65 const T chi = G.chi.ptr()[id];
66 const T inv_chi = T(1) / chi;
67 const T K_val = G.K.ptr()[id];
68
69 T gamma_tilde_inv[3][3];
70 T gamma_phys[3][3];
71 T gamma_phys_inv[3][3];
72 T A_mat[3][3];
73
74 for (int a = 0; a < 3; ++a) {
75 for (int b = a; b < 3; ++b) {
76 const int s = tensorium_RG::sym6_index(a, b);
77 const T gt = tensorium_RG::sym6_get(G.gamma_tilde, id, a, b);
78 const T gt_inv = tensorium_RG::sym6_get(G.gamma_tilde_inv, id, a, b);
79 const T Aval = tensorium_RG::sym6_get(G.A_tilde, id, a, b);
80
81 gamma_tilde_inv[a][b] = gt_inv;
82 gamma_tilde_inv[b][a] = gt_inv;
83
84 const T g_phys = gt * inv_chi;
85 const T g_phys_inv = gt_inv * chi;
86 gamma_phys[a][b] = g_phys;
87 gamma_phys[b][a] = g_phys;
88 gamma_phys_inv[a][b] = g_phys_inv;
89 gamma_phys_inv[b][a] = g_phys_inv;
90
91 A_mat[a][b] = Aval;
92 A_mat[b][a] = Aval;
93 }
94 }
95
96 const T beta_x = G.beta[0].ptr()[id];
97 const T beta_y = G.beta[1].ptr()[id];
98 const T beta_z = G.beta[2].ptr()[id];
99
100 const T adv = beta_x * T(Dx_upwind(G.K, i, j, k, G.dx, beta_x)) +
101 beta_y * T(Dy_upwind(G.K, i, j, k, G.dy, beta_y)) +
102 beta_z * T(Dz_upwind(G.K, i, j, k, G.dz, beta_z));
103
104 const T d_alpha[3] = {T(Dx(G.alpha, i, j, k, G.dx)), T(Dy(G.alpha, i, j, k, G.dy)),
105 T(Dz(G.alpha, i, j, k, G.dz))};
106 const T d_chi[3] = {T(Dx(G.chi, i, j, k, G.dx)), T(Dy(G.chi, i, j, k, G.dy)),
107 T(Dz(G.chi, i, j, k, G.dz))};
108
109 T d_g_phys[3][3][3];
110 for (int dir = 0; dir < 3; ++dir)
111 for (int row = 0; row < 3; ++row)
112 for (int col = 0; col < 3; ++col)
113 d_g_phys[dir][row][col] = T(0);
114
115 for (int dir = 0; dir < 3; ++dir) {
116 for (int row = 0; row < 3; ++row) {
117 for (int col = row; col < 3; ++col) {
118 const int s = tensorium_RG::sym6_index(row, col);
119 T d_gt = T(0);
120 if (dir == 0)
121 d_gt = T(Dx(G.gamma_tilde[s], i, j, k, G.dx));
122 else if (dir == 1)
123 d_gt = T(Dy(G.gamma_tilde[s], i, j, k, G.dy));
124 else
125 d_gt = T(Dz(G.gamma_tilde[s], i, j, k, G.dz));
126
127 const T val = d_gt * inv_chi - gamma_phys[row][col] * inv_chi * d_chi[dir];
128 d_g_phys[dir][row][col] = val;
129 d_g_phys[dir][col][row] = val;
130 }
131 }
132 }
133
134 T Gamma_conn[3][3][3];
135 for (int idx_k = 0; idx_k < 3; ++idx_k)
136 for (int row = 0; row < 3; ++row)
137 for (int col = 0; col < 3; ++col)
138 Gamma_conn[idx_k][row][col] = T(0);
139
140 for (int idx_k = 0; idx_k < 3; ++idx_k) {
141 for (int row = 0; row < 3; ++row) {
142 for (int col = row; col < 3; ++col) {
143 T sum = T(0);
144 for (int l = 0; l < 3; ++l) {
145 const T term = d_g_phys[row][col][l] + d_g_phys[col][row][l] -
146 d_g_phys[l][row][col];
147 sum += gamma_phys_inv[idx_k][l] * term;
148 }
149 const T val = T(0.5) * sum;
150 Gamma_conn[idx_k][row][col] = val;
151 Gamma_conn[idx_k][col][row] = val;
152 }
153 }
154 }
155
156 T hess[3][3];
157 hess[0][0] = T(Dxx(G.alpha, i, j, k, G.dx));
158 hess[1][1] = T(Dyy(G.alpha, i, j, k, G.dy));
159 hess[2][2] = T(Dzz(G.alpha, i, j, k, G.dz));
160 hess[0][1] = T(Dxy4(G.alpha, i, j, k, G.dx, G.dy));
161 hess[0][2] = T(Dxz4(G.alpha, i, j, k, G.dx, G.dz));
162 hess[1][2] = T(Dyz4(G.alpha, i, j, k, G.dy, G.dz));
163 hess[1][0] = hess[0][1];
164 hess[2][0] = hess[0][2];
165 hess[2][1] = hess[1][2];
166
167 T cov_dd[3][3];
168 for (int row = 0; row < 3; ++row) {
169 for (int col = row; col < 3; ++col) {
170 T conn_grad = T(0);
171 for (int l = 0; l < 3; ++l)
172 conn_grad += Gamma_conn[l][row][col] * d_alpha[l];
173 const T val = hess[row][col] - conn_grad;
174 cov_dd[row][col] = val;
175 cov_dd[col][row] = val;
176 }
177 }
178
179 T laplacian = T(0);
180 for (int row = 0; row < 3; ++row)
181 for (int col = 0; col < 3; ++col)
182 laplacian += gamma_phys_inv[row][col] * cov_dd[row][col];
183
184 T A_up[3][3];
185 for (int row = 0; row < 3; ++row)
186 for (int col = row; col < 3; ++col) {
187 T sum = T(0);
188 for (int m = 0; m < 3; ++m)
189 for (int n = 0; n < 3; ++n)
190 sum += gamma_tilde_inv[row][m] * gamma_tilde_inv[col][n] * A_mat[m][n];
191 A_up[row][col] = sum;
192 A_up[col][row] = sum;
193 }
194
195 T A_contract = T(0);
196 for (int row = 0; row < 3; ++row)
197 for (int col = 0; col < 3; ++col)
198 A_contract += A_mat[row][col] * A_up[row][col];
199
200 const T quad = alpha * (A_contract + third * K_val * K_val);
201
202 rhs_K.ptr()[id] = adv - laplacian + quad + T(KO6(G.K, i, j, k, ko_sigma));
203 }
204 }
205 }
206}
